name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
summary: A standing free-weight isolation movement targeting the elbow flexors by curling a pair of dumbbells toward the shoulders.

setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly unlocked.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with your palms facing forward and shoulders pulled back and down.
steps: Keeping your upper arms pinned by your ribs, flex your elbows to curl the dumbbells upward.
Lift the weights until your biceps are fully contracted near shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top to squeeze the biceps.
Lower the dumbbells smoothly back to the starting position under control until your arms are fully extended.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you curl the dumbbells up, and inhale as you lower them under control.

common_faults.fault: Swinging the torso and using hip momentum to lift the dumbbells.
common_faults.correction: Brace your core and keep your torso completely still throughout the set.

common_faults.fault: Drifting the elbows forward to make the top of the movement easier.
common_faults.correction: Keep your upper arms stationary and perpendicular to the floor.

precautions: Select a load that allows full extension without hyperextending the lower back.
